name: Varuckan Soulknife can be activated from the material deck in the main phase by banishing three fire cards from the graveyard
notes: An Assassin fire champion clicks Varuckan Soulknife, banishes three Red Slimes from the graveyard and confirms the materialize. The materialize phase only offers this clause to a player who takes part in the ordinary materialize (declining it skips the offer), so the card is also activatable by clicking it in the material deck during the main phase.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] [Element Bonus] You may banish three fire element cards from your graveyard to activate this card from your material deck.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Varuckan Soulknife could only be activated from the material deck through the materialize-phase offer, which a declined ordinary materialize skips; it had no main-phase activation.
